supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceLearningGoals: Assess the reasonableness of answers using mental computation and estimation strategies including rounding. Solve two-step word problems using addition and subtraction in a way that makes sense to them.
teachingSteps: Identify hundreds, tens and ones in each number.
Use a place-value drawing, number line or algorithm appropriate to this lesson.
Check the answer by the inverse operation or a reasonable estimate.
